summary: Tiny strip of shop bays in West End, apartments 5 m away.
reasons: Narrow strip, barely room for a van

best_section.where: Short row of bays off Laurence Street between Vinnies and the apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Mapped apartments 'London' 5 m away and 'The Bailey' 15 m away; tall residential and commercial buildings all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow strip beside the lane, a van would overhang the lane or block bays.
drivers.traffic: Inner-city street with shops and apartments around.
drivers.convention: Mapped parking is customers-only; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Mostly shaded by tall buildings either side; open overhead at midday.
cannot_judge: Whether bollards at the north end block entry
